source.text: וַיּוֹלִכֵ֖נִי אֶל־הַשָּׁ֑עַר שַׁ֕עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פֹּנֶ֖ה דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he led me to the gate, [the] gate which [was] facing [the] way of the east.

en.L: Then he led me to the gate, the gate that faces toward the east.
en.B: Then the man brought me to the gate, the one that faces east.
en.R: Then the man took me to the gate that faces east.

es.L: Luego me condujo a la puerta, la puerta que mira hacia el oriente.
es.B: Después el hombre me llevó a la puerta, la que mira al oriente.
es.R: Luego el hombre me llevó a la puerta que mira al oriente.

fr.L: Puis il me conduisit à la porte, la porte qui fait face vers l’est.
fr.B: Puis l’homme m’amena à la porte, celle qui fait face à l’est.
fr.R: Ensuite, l’homme m’a emmené à la porte qui fait face à l’est.

sw.L: Kisha akaniongoza mpaka lango, lango linaloelekea upande wa mashariki.
sw.B: Kisha yule mtu akanileta mpaka lango, lile linaloelekea mashariki.
sw.R: Kisha yule mtu akanipeleka mpaka lango linaloelekea mashariki.

vi.L: Rồi người dẫn tôi đến cổng, cổng hướng về phía đông.
vi.B: Rồi người ấy đưa tôi đến cổng, là cổng hướng về phía đông.
vi.R: Rồi người ấy đưa tôi đến cổng hướng về phía đông.

decisions.choice: the gate that faces east: the gate by which the glory left
decisions.reason: The glory of the LORD left the temple by the east gate (10:19; 11:1, 23). Now Ezekiel is brought to the same gate to see it return.

decisions.choice: the man (B, R)
decisions.reason: The guide of 40:3 is named, so that he is not taken for the LORD.

source.text: וְהִנֵּ֗ה כְּבוֹד֙ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל בָּ֖א מִדֶּ֣רֶךְ הַקָּדִ֑ים וְקוֹל֗וֹ כְּקוֹל֙ מַ֣יִם רַבִּ֔ים וְהָאָ֖רֶץ הֵאִ֥ירָה מִכְּבֹדֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: And look, [the] glory of [the] God of Israel [was] coming from [the] way of the east, and its sound like [the] sound of many waters, and the earth shone from his glory.

en.L: And look, the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the way of the east; and its sound [was] like the sound of many waters, and the earth shone with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.B: And there was the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east. The sound of its coming was like the roar of rushing waters, and the earth shone with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.
en.R: Then I saw that the glory of the God of Israel was coming from the east. It made a sound like the roar of a flood. The land was bright with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} glory.

es.L: Y he aquí, la gloria del Dios de Israel venía del camino del oriente; y su sonido [era] como el sonido de muchas aguas, y la tierra resplandecía por {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.B: Y allí estaba la gloria del Dios de Israel, que venía del oriente. El ruido de su llegada era como el estruendo de aguas caudalosas, y la tierra resplandecía con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.
es.R: Entonces vi que la gloria del Dios de Israel venía del oriente. Hacía un ruido como el estruendo de una inundación. La tierra brillaba con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} gloria.

fr.L: Et voici, la gloire du Dieu d’Israël venait du chemin de l’est ; et son bruit [était] comme le bruit de grandes eaux, et la terre resplendissait de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.B: Et voici que la gloire du Dieu d’Israël arrivait de l’est. Le bruit de sa venue était comme le grondement des grandes eaux, et la terre resplendissait de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.
fr.R: Alors j’ai vu que la gloire du Dieu d’Israël arrivait de l’est. Elle faisait un bruit semblable au grondement d’un torrent en crue. La terre brillait de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} gloire.

sw.L: Na tazama, utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ulikuwa ukija kutoka njia ya mashariki; na sauti yake [ilikuwa] kama sauti ya maji mengi, na nchi ikang'aa kwa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: Na tazama, utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ulikuwa ukija kutoka mashariki. Sauti ya kuja kwake ilikuwa kama ngurumo ya maji yanayovuma, nayo nchi ikang'aa kwa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: Kisha nikaona utukufu wa Mungu wa Israeli ukija kutoka mashariki. Ulitoa sauti kama ngurumo ya mafuriko. Nchi ikang'aa kwa utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

vi.L: Kìa, vinh quang của Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên từ hướng đông đang đến; tiếng của nó [như] tiếng của nhiều dòng nước, và đất chiếu sáng bởi vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Kìa, vinh quang của Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên đang từ phía đông đến. Tiếng vinh quang ấy đến như tiếng ầm ầm của dòng nước lớn, và đất sáng rực vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Rồi tôi thấy vinh quang của Đức Chúa Trời của Y-sơ-ra-ên đang từ phía đông đến. Có tiếng ầm ầm như tiếng nước lũ. Cả xứ sáng rực vinh quang của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: the glory of the God of Israel coming from the east: the glory returns
decisions.reason: In 11:22-23 the glory of the God of Israel left the city and stood on the mountain to the east. Now it comes back from the same direction. Isaiah 40:3-5 and 52:8 speak of the LORD's return to Zion; Ezekiel sees it.

decisions.choice: like the sound of many waters: as the sound of the living creatures' wings in 1:24
decisions.reason: The same words describe the sound of the vision by the Kebar (1:24). Revelation 1:15 and 14:2 use the phrase for the voice of Christ and the sound from heaven.

decisions.choice: the earth shone with his glory: the brightness of the LORD's presence
decisions.reason: The light of the glory fills the land. Revelation 21:23 says the holy city needs no sun, because the glory of God gives it light.

decisions.choice: the roar of rushing waters (B); the roar of a flood (R)
decisions.reason: As 1:24 at each level. Literal keeps "the sound of many waters".

decisions.choice: "el estruendo de aguas caudalosas" (B); "el estruendo de una inundación" (R)
decisions.reason: The same words as the published Spanish of 1:24, which the meaning decision points to, so that the reader hears the first vision again.

decisions.choice: "vinh quang của Đức Chúa Trời"; "vinh quang của Ngài" with the deity_pronoun span
decisions.reason: The glory of the LORD is "vinh quang của CHÚA" at every level, as Isaiah 40:5; the possessive pronoun for God takes the span as the English does.

decisions.choice: deity_pronoun spans only on free pronouns and possessives (utukufu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}})
decisions.reason: As the Swahili style guide: a verb prefix or object marker cannot take a capital, so this chapter has fewer spans than the English; they go on the LORD's own possessives and free pronouns (43:2, 7-9) and on no one else.

source.text: וּכְמַרְאֵ֨ה הַמַּרְאֶ֜ה אֲשֶׁ֣ר רָאִ֗יתִי כַּמַּרְאֶ֤ה אֲשֶׁר־רָאִ֨יתִי֙ בְּבֹאִי֙ לְשַׁחֵ֣ת אֶת־הָעִ֔יר וּמַרְא֕וֹת כַּמַּרְאֶ֕ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר רָאִ֖יתִי אֶל־נְהַר־כְּבָ֑ר וָאֶפֹּ֖ל אֶל־פָּנָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And like [the] appearance of the vision which I saw, like the vision which I saw when I came to destroy the city, and visions like the vision which I saw by [the] river Kebar; and I fell on my face.

en.L: And the appearance of the vision that I saw [was] like the vision that I had seen when I came to destroy the city; [these were] visions like the vision I had seen by the river Kebar; and I fell on my face.
en.B: What I saw in this vision was like what I had seen when I came to destroy the city, and like the vision I had seen by the Kebar Canal, and I fell face down.
en.R: What I saw looked like the vision I had seen when I came to announce that the city would be destroyed. It was also like the vision I had seen by the Kebar Canal. I bowed down with my face to the ground.

es.L: Y el aspecto de la visión que vi [era] como la visión que había visto cuando vine a destruir la ciudad; [eran] visiones como la visión que había visto junto al río Quebar; y caí sobre mi rostro.
es.B: Lo que vi en esta visión era como lo que había visto cuando vine a destruir la ciudad, y como la visión que había visto junto al canal Quebar; y caí rostro en tierra.
es.R: Lo que vi se parecía a la visión que había tenido cuando vine a anunciar que la ciudad sería destruida. También se parecía a la visión que había tenido junto al canal Quebar. Me incliné con el rostro en tierra.

fr.L: Et l’aspect de la vision que je vis [était] comme la vision que j’avais vue quand je vins pour détruire la ville ; [c’étaient] des visions comme la vision que j’avais vue près du fleuve Kebar ; et je tombai sur ma face.
fr.B: Ce que je vis dans cette vision ressemblait à ce que j’avais vu quand j’étais venu détruire la ville, et à la vision que j’avais eue près du canal de Kebar ; et je tombai face contre terre.
fr.R: Ce que j’ai vu ressemblait à la vision que j’avais eue quand j’étais venu annoncer que la ville serait détruite. Cela ressemblait aussi à la vision que j’avais eue près du canal de Kebar. Je me suis prosterné, le visage contre le sol.

sw.L: Na sura ya maono niliyoyaona [ilikuwa] kama maono niliyoyaona nilipokuja kuuangamiza mji; [yalikuwa] maono kama maono niliyoyaona karibu na mto Kebari; nami nikaanguka kifudifudi.
sw.B: Nilichokiona katika maono haya kilikuwa kama kile nilichokiona nilipokuja kuuangamiza mji, na kama maono niliyoyaona kando ya mfereji wa Kebari, nami nikaanguka kifudifudi.
sw.R: Nilichokiona kilifanana na maono niliyoyaona nilipokuja kutangaza kwamba mji ungeangamizwa. Kilifanana pia na maono niliyoyaona kando ya mfereji wa Kebari. Nikainama mpaka uso wangu ukagusa ardhi.

vi.L: Diện mạo của khải tượng mà tôi thấy [giống] như khải tượng tôi đã thấy khi tôi đến để hủy diệt thành; [đó là] những khải tượng giống như khải tượng tôi đã thấy bên sông Kê-ba; và tôi sấp mặt xuống.
vi.B: Điều tôi thấy trong khải tượng này giống như điều tôi đã thấy khi tôi đến để hủy diệt thành, và giống như khải tượng tôi đã thấy bên kênh Kê-ba. Tôi sấp mặt xuống đất.
vi.R: Điều tôi thấy giống như khải tượng tôi đã thấy khi tôi đến loan báo rằng thành sẽ bị hủy diệt. Nó cũng giống như khải tượng tôi đã thấy bên kênh Kê-ba. Tôi cúi rạp mặt xuống đất.

decisions.choice: when I came to destroy the city: when Ezekiel announced its destruction
alternatives: when he came to destroy the city
decisions.reason: Ezekiel did not destroy Jerusalem himself, but in the vision of chapters 8-11 he saw its destruction ordered and proclaimed it (9:1-11). A prophet is sometimes said to do what he announces (Jeremiah 1:10). Some Hebrew manuscripts and the Latin read "when he came", meaning the LORD.

decisions.choice: the vision by the river Kebar: chapter 1
decisions.reason: Ezekiel names both earlier visions of the glory: by the Kebar (1:1-28; 3:23) and in the temple (8:4; 10:15-22). The glory he saw leave is the glory he now sees return.

decisions.choice: I fell on my face: in awe before the glory
decisions.reason: As in 1:28 and 3:23.

decisions.choice: when I came to announce that the city would be destroyed (R)
decisions.reason: Readable makes plain how the prophet "came to destroy" the city (m1).

decisions.choice: the river Kebar (L); the Kebar Canal (B, R)
I fell face down (B); I bowed down with my face to the ground (R)
"sông Kê-ba" (L) / "kênh Kê-ba" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for Ezekiel: the Kebar was an irrigation canal near Babylon, which Balanced and Readable name, as the English does.

decisions.choice: mto Kebari (Literal); mfereji wa Kebari (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for Ezekiel, following the English levels (the river Kebar / the Kebar Canal).

source.text: וּכְב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה בָּ֣א אֶל־הַבָּ֑יִת דֶּ֣רֶךְ שַׁ֔עַר אֲשֶׁ֥ר פָּנָ֖יו דֶּ֥רֶךְ הַקָּדִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] glory of Yahweh came into the house [by] [the] way of [the] gate whose face [was] [the] way of the east.

en.L: And the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came into the house by way of the gate that faces toward the east.
en.B: The glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came into the temple through the gate that faces east.
en.R: The glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} entered the temple through the east gate.

es.L: Y la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entró en la casa por el camino de la puerta que mira hacia el oriente.
es.B: La gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entró en el templo por la puerta que mira al oriente.
es.R: La gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} entró en el templo por la puerta oriental.

fr.L: Et la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} entra dans la maison par le chemin de la porte qui fait face vers l’est.
fr.B: La gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} entra dans le temple par la porte qui fait face à l’est.
fr.R: La gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est entrée dans le temple par la porte est.

sw.L: Na utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukaingia ndani ya nyumba kwa njia ya lango linaloelekea upande wa mashariki.
sw.B: Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukaingia ndani ya hekalu kupitia lango linaloelekea mashariki.
sw.R: Utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukaingia ndani ya hekalu kupitia lango la mashariki.

vi.L: Vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào nhà theo đường cổng hướng về phía đông.
vi.B: Vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} vào đền thờ qua cổng hướng về phía đông.
vi.R: Vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đi vào đền thờ qua cổng phía đông.

decisions.choice: the glory of the LORD came into the house: the LORD returns to dwell among his people
decisions.reason: This is the turning point of the book. The glory that left in 10:18-19 and 11:23 because of Israel's sins now enters the new temple, as the glory filled the tabernacle (Exodus 40:34-35) and Solomon's temple (1 Kings 8:10-11). 44:2 says the gate is shut afterward, because the LORD has entered by it.

source.text: וַתִּשָּׂאֵ֣נִי ר֔וּחַ וַתְּבִיאֵ֕נִי אֶל־הֶֽחָצֵ֖ר הַפְּנִימִ֑י וְהִנֵּ֛ה מָלֵ֥א כְבוֹד־יְהוָ֖ה הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] Spirit lifted me up and brought me into the court the inner, and look, [the] glory of Yahweh filled the house.

en.L: And the Spirit lifted me and brought me to the inner court; and look, the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the house.
en.B: Then the Spirit lifted me and carried me into the inner court, and there the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was filling the temple.
en.R: Then the Spirit lifted me up and took me into the inner courtyard. I saw that the glory of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} filled the temple.

es.L: Y el Espíritu me alzó y me llevó al atrio interior; y he aquí, la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenó la casa.
es.B: Entonces el Espíritu me levantó y me llevó al atrio interior, y allí la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenaba el templo.
es.R: Luego el Espíritu me levantó y me llevó al atrio interior. Vi que la gloria {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} llenaba el templo.

fr.L: Et l’Esprit m’enleva et me fit entrer dans le parvis intérieur ; et voici, la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait la maison.
fr.B: Alors l’Esprit m’enleva et me transporta dans le parvis intérieur, et voici que la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait le temple.
fr.R: Alors l’Esprit m’a soulevé et m’a emmené dans le parvis intérieur. J’ai vu que la gloire {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} remplissait le temple.

sw.L: Na Roho akaniinua, akanileta mpaka ua wa ndani; na tazama, utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ukaijaza nyumba.
sw.B: Kisha Roho akaniinua, akanipeleka ndani ya ua wa ndani, na huko utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulikuwa ukilijaza hekalu.
sw.R: Kisha Roho akaniinua, akanipeleka ndani ya ua wa ndani. Nikaona kwamba utukufu wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ulilijaza hekalu.

vi.L: Thần Linh nhấc tôi lên và đem tôi vào sân trong; và kìa, vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy nhà.
vi.B: Rồi Thần Linh nhấc tôi lên và đem tôi vào sân trong, và kìa, vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy đền thờ.
vi.R: Rồi Thần Linh nhấc tôi lên và đưa tôi vào sân trong. Tôi thấy vinh quang của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đầy dẫy đền thờ.

decisions.choice: the Spirit: God's Spirit, who lifts Ezekiel
decisions.reason: As in 3:12, 3:14, 8:3 and 11:1, 24, it is the Spirit who lifts and carries the prophet in the vision.

decisions.choice: the glory of the LORD filled the house: as at the tabernacle and Solomon's temple
decisions.reason: The words recall Exodus 40:34-35 and 1 Kings 8:10-11, where the glory filled the newly made sanctuary. Ezekiel saw the glory fill the court of the old temple as it was leaving (10:4); now it fills the new one.

decisions.choice: the Spirit (all levels)
decisions.reason: Capitalized, as in 2:2 and 3:12, for the Spirit who lifts Ezekiel.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh", capitalised
decisions.reason: God's Spirit, as Isaiah 44:3 and the Ezekiel term sheet; the Old Testament keeps "Thần Linh" where the New Testament says "Thánh Linh".

decisions.choice: Roho (capital), with personal agreement (Roho akaniinua)
decisions.reason: God's Spirit is "Roho" with a capital, as the term sheet for Ezekiel; "roho" and "upepo" are kept for a human spirit and for wind.

source.text: וָאֶשְׁמַ֛ע מִדַּבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י מֵהַבָּ֑יִת וְאִ֕ישׁ הָיָ֥ה עֹמֵ֖ד אֶצְלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And I heard [one] speaking to me from the house, and a man was standing beside me.

en.L: And I heard [someone] speaking to me from the house, while the man was standing beside me.
en.B: While the man stood beside me, I heard someone speak to me out of the temple.
en.R: The man was standing beside me. Then I heard someone speaking to me from inside the temple.

es.L: Y oí a [alguien] que me hablaba desde la casa, mientras el hombre estaba de pie junto a mí.
es.B: Mientras el hombre estaba de pie a mi lado, oí que alguien me hablaba desde el templo.
es.R: El hombre estaba de pie a mi lado. Entonces oí que alguien me hablaba desde dentro del templo.

fr.L: Et j’entendis [quelqu’un] qui me parlait depuis la maison, tandis que l’homme se tenait à côté de moi.
fr.B: Tandis que l’homme se tenait à côté de moi, j’entendis quelqu’un me parler depuis le temple.
fr.R: L’homme se tenait à côté de moi. Alors j’ai entendu quelqu’un qui me parlait depuis l’intérieur du temple.

sw.L: Nikasikia [mtu] akisema nami kutoka nyumbani, huku yule mtu amesimama kando yangu.
sw.B: Yule mtu alipokuwa amesimama kando yangu, nilisikia mtu akisema nami kutoka ndani ya hekalu.
sw.R: Yule mtu alikuwa amesimama kando yangu. Kisha nikasikia mtu akisema nami kutoka ndani ya hekalu.

vi.L: Tôi nghe [có ai] từ trong nhà nói với tôi, trong khi người kia đang đứng bên cạnh tôi.
vi.B: Trong khi người ấy đứng bên cạnh tôi, tôi nghe có ai từ trong đền thờ nói với tôi.
vi.R: Người ấy đang đứng bên cạnh tôi. Rồi tôi nghe có ai từ bên trong đền thờ nói với tôi.

decisions.choice: one speaking to me from the house: the LORD himself
decisions.reason: The speaker is not named, but he speaks of "my throne" and "my holy name" (verse 7). It is the LORD, speaking from his house, as the voice spoke from above the throne in 1:28-2:1. The guide stands beside Ezekiel and is distinct from the speaker.

decisions.choice: a man was standing beside me: the guide of chapters 40-42
decisions.reason: The "man" is the man of 40:3, who stays at Ezekiel's side as the LORD speaks.

decisions.choice: someone (all levels)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves the speaker unnamed (m1), and every level keeps him unnamed, as Ezekiel keeps his distance in describing the LORD (1:28).

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלַ֗י בֶּן־אָדָם֙ אֶת־מְק֣וֹם כִּסְאִ֗י וְאֶת־מְקוֹם֙ כַּפּ֣וֹת רַגְלַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֧ר אֶשְׁכָּן־שָׁ֛ם בְּת֥וֹךְ בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְעוֹלָ֑ם וְלֹ֣א יְטַמְּא֣וּ ע֣וֹד בֵּֽית־יִ֠שְׂרָאֵל שֵׁ֣ם קָדְשִׁ֞י הֵ֤מָּה וּמַלְכֵיהֶם֙ בִּזְנוּתָ֔ם וּבְפִגְרֵ֥י מַלְכֵיהֶ֖ם בָּמוֹתָֽם׃

Here I will live among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} forever. Never again will the house of Israel defile {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} holy name, neither they nor their kings, with their prostitution and with the dead bodies of their kings at their high places,

I will live here among the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} forever. Nunca más profanará la casa de Israel {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} santo nombre, ni ellos ni sus reyes, con su prostitución y con los cadáveres de sus reyes en sus lugares altos,

J’habiterai ici au milieu des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} pour toujours. Le peuple d’Israël et ses rois ne déshonoreront plus jamais {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} saint nom en {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}étant infidèles. Na nyumba ya Israeli hawatalitia tena unajisi jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} takatifu, wao na wafalme wao, kwa ukahaba wao na kwa maiti za wafalme wao [katika] mahali pao pa juu,

Nitaishi hapa kati ya Waisraeli milele. Watu wa Israeli na wafalme wao hawatalivunjia tena heshima jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} takatifu kwa kutokuwa waaminifu {{deity_pronoun:kwangu|Kwangu}}. Hawatalivunjia heshima kwa maiti za wafalme wao katika mahali pao pa ibada vilimani.

vi.L: Ngài phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, [đây là] chỗ ngai của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và chỗ đặt bàn chân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ngự giữa con cái Y-sơ-ra-ên đời đời. Nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ không còn làm ô uế danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa, cả họ lẫn các vua của họ, bởi sự dâm loạn của họ và bởi thây các vua của họ [tại] các nơi cao của họ,
vi.B: Ngài phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, đây là ngai của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, và đây là chỗ bàn chân {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt lên. Tại đây {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở giữa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên đời đời. Nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên sẽ không bao giờ làm ô uế danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa, cả họ lẫn các vua của họ, bằng sự dâm loạn của họ và bằng xác các vua của họ tại các nơi cao của họ,
vi.R: Ngài phán với tôi: "Hỡi con người, đây là nơi đặt ngai của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, nơi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đặt chân. {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sống ở đây giữa dân Y-sơ-ra-ên mãi mãi. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và các vua của họ sẽ không bao giờ còn làm nhục danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng cách bất trung với {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} nữa. Họ sẽ không làm nhục danh ấy bằng xác các vua của họ tại các miếu thờ trên đồi.

decisions.choice: the place of my throne and the place of the soles of my feet: the temple as the LORD's throne room and footstool
decisions.reason: Elsewhere the ark (1 Chronicles 28:2), the temple (Psalm 132:7; Isaiah 60:13) and Zion are the LORD's footstool, and Jerusalem is his throne (Jeremiah 3:17; 17:12). Ezekiel's temple has no ark; the LORD himself is enthroned there. The throne recalls the throne above the living creatures (1:26; 10:1).

decisions.choice: where I will dwell among the sons of Israel forever: the promise of 37:26-28
decisions.reason: The verb is the one used for the LORD's dwelling in the tabernacle (Exodus 25:8; 29:45). 37:27-28 promised that his sanctuary would be among them forever; here the promise is kept. Revelation 21:3 echoes it: "the dwelling of God is with men".

decisions.choice: the corpses of their kings: perhaps the monuments or burials of kings near the temple
alternatives: the lifeless idols of their kings
decisions.reason: The word usually means "corpses". The kings of Judah were buried in the city of David, close to the temple (1 Kings 2:10; 2 Kings 21:18, 26), and some think of royal tombs, or of memorial stones or offerings for the dead kings. Others take the word as "lifeless idols" (as Leviticus 26:30). The exact sense is uncertain.

decisions.choice: their high places: some manuscripts read "at their death"
decisions.reason: The written Hebrew "their high places" differs by one vowel from "their death", which some Hebrew manuscripts and ancient versions read: "the corpses of their kings at their death". The translation keeps "their high places".

decisions.choice: prostitution: unfaithfulness to the LORD in the worship of other gods
decisions.reason: As in chapters 16 and 23, the word pictures idolatry as a wife's unfaithfulness.

decisions.choice: my, me: deity_pronoun spans (all levels)
decisions.reason: The LORD speaks of himself, and the pronouns take the setting for pronouns for God, as for the figure in 1:26-28.

decisions.choice: sons of Israel (L); {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: The book's usual rendering; the people as a whole are meant.

decisions.choice: being unfaithful to me (R)
decisions.reason: As the terms note gives "be unfaithful" at Readable for Israel's unfaithfulness to God.

decisions.choice: high places (L, B); hilltop shrines (R)
decisions.reason: The book's usual wording (6:3).

decisions.choice: "los israelitas" (B, R), with no gender span
decisions.reason: Spanish "israelitas" already includes women and men, so the English gender span has no Spanish counterpart; L keeps "los hijos de Israel".

decisions.choice: "fils d'homme" for God's address to Ezekiel, at every level, lowercase, with no article and no gender span
decisions.reason: As the term sheet and Ezekiel 2:1: the phrase means "human being" and must not read as Jesus's title "le Fils de l'homme"; recorded once for chapters 41-48.

decisions.choice: "les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d'Israël" (L) / "les {{gender:Israélites|fils d'Israël}}" (B, R); the English Literal has no span
alternatives: "les fils d'Israël" with no span at Literal
decisions.reason: The term sheet's form for the whole of Ezekiel, as the Pentateuch.

decisions.choice: "Hỡi con người", lowercase, at every level, with "ngươi" (L) / "con" (B, R) for God's address to Ezekiel
decisions.reason: God's ben-'adam to Ezekiel means "human being", which is what Vietnamese "con người" says; it is never capitalised, since "Con Người" is Jesus' title in the Gospels (Matthew 24:30). As in God's other commissions to the prophets, he says "ngươi" at Literal and "con" at Balanced and Readable; God's "Ta" mid-sentence takes the deity_pronoun span.

decisions.choice: "dân Y-sơ-ra-ên" with no gender span where the English has {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}}
decisions.reason: Vietnamese "dân" (and Literal's "con cái") already includes men and women, so there is only one wording and no setting.

decisions.choice: "sự dâm loạn" (L, B) / "bất trung" (R); "các nơi cao" (L, B) / "các miếu thờ trên đồi" (R)
decisions.reason: The noun as in Ezekiel 16:15 ("sự dâm loạn"), for unfaithfulness to the LORD; Readable says what it means, as the English R does. "Nơi cao" is the Kings word for high places.

decisions.choice: wana wa Israeli (Literal); Waisraeli (Balanced, Readable), no gender span
decisions.reason: "Waisraeli" and "wana wa Israeli" already include men and women, as in the published Swahili, so the English gender setting has no Swahili counterpart here or elsewhere in chapters 43-48.

decisions.choice: ukahaba (Literal, Balanced); kutokuwa waaminifu kwangu (Readable)
decisions.reason: As the term sheet's wording for zanah in Ezekiel: the figure of prostitution for worship of other gods is kept at Literal and Balanced and said plainly at Readable, as the English Readable does.

Ils ont déshonoré {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} saint nom par les choses dégoûtantes qu’ils ont faites. Alors, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, je les ai détruits.

Nao wakalitia unajisi jina {{deity_pronoun:langu|Langu}} takatifu kwa machukizo yao waliyoyafanya, kwa hiyo nikawaangamiza katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.

vi.L: khi họ đặt ngưỡng cửa của họ cạnh ngưỡng cửa của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và trụ cửa của họ bên cạnh trụ cửa của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, [chỉ có] bức tường ở giữa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} và họ. Họ đã làm nhục danh thánh của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} bằng những việc ghê tởm họ đã làm. Vì vậy, trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã tiêu diệt họ.

decisions.choice: their threshold by my threshold: the palace built next to the temple
decisions.reason: Solomon built his palace beside the temple, in the same enclosure (1 Kings 7:1-12). The kings' house and the LORD's house shared walls, and the kings brought their idolatry close to the LORD's presence (2 Kings 21:4-5; 23:11-12). In the new temple the land of the prince is kept apart from the sanctuary (45:7-8; 48:21).

decisions.choice: abominations (L); detestable practices (B); disgusting things (R)
decisions.reason: The book's usual wording for this word (5:9).

decisions.choice: the doorways of their palaces (R)
decisions.reason: Readable says whose thresholds these were (m1).

decisions.choice: "điều ghê tởm" (L) / "việc làm ghê tởm" (B) / "việc ghê tởm" (R) for to'evah
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel term sheet's forms, as Deuteronomy 18:12.

decisions.choice: machukizo (Literal); matendo ya kuchukiza (Balanced); mambo ya kinyaa (Readable)
decisions.reason: The term sheet's wording for to'evah throughout Ezekiel.

records.literal_gloss: Now let them put far away their prostitution and [the] corpses of their kings from me, and I will dwell among them forever.

en.L: Now let them put away their prostitution and the corpses of their kings far from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will dwell among them forever.
en.B: Now let them put their prostitution and the dead bodies of their kings far away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, and I will live among them forever.
en.R: Now they must get rid of their unfaithfulness and take the dead bodies of their kings far away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. Then I will live among them forever.

es.L: Ahora, que alejen de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} su prostitución y los cadáveres de sus reyes, y habitaré en medio de ellos para siempre.
es.B: Que alejen ahora de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} su prostitución y los cadáveres de sus reyes, y viviré en medio de ellos para siempre.
es.R: Ahora tienen que dejar de ser{{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} infieles y llevarse lejos de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}} los cadáveres de sus reyes. Entonces viviré en medio de ellos para siempre.

fr.L: Maintenant, qu’ils éloignent loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} leur prostitution et les cadavres de leurs rois, et je demeurerai au milieu d’eux pour toujours.
fr.B: Qu’ils rejettent maintenant loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} leur prostitution et les cadavres de leurs rois, et j’habiterai au milieu d’eux pour toujours.
fr.R: Maintenant, ils doivent abandonner leur infidélité et emporter loin de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}} les cadavres de leurs rois. Alors j’habiterai au milieu d’eux pour toujours.

sw.L: Sasa na waweke mbali ukahaba wao na maiti za wafalme wao mbali {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, nami nitakaa katikati yao milele.
sw.B: Sasa na wauweke ukahaba wao na maiti za wafalme wao mbali {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}, nami nitaishi kati yao milele.
sw.R: Sasa lazima waache kutokuwa waaminifu, na kuziondoa maiti za wafalme wao mbali {{deity_pronoun:nami|Nami}}. Ndipo nitaishi kati yao milele.

vi.L: Bây giờ hãy để họ dẹp sự dâm loạn của họ và thây các vua của họ xa khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ngự giữa họ đời đời.
vi.B: Bây giờ họ phải dẹp bỏ sự dâm loạn của họ và đem xác các vua của họ ra xa khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, thì {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ ở giữa họ đời đời.
vi.R: Bây giờ họ phải từ bỏ sự bất trung, và đem xác các vua của họ ra xa khỏi {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. Khi ấy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} sẽ sống giữa họ mãi mãi.

decisions.choice: now let them put away ... and I will dwell: the LORD's presence requires the removal of what defiles
decisions.reason: The verse joins a command with a promise. When the people remove what has defiled the LORD's name, he will dwell among them for ever (verse 7).

decisions.choice: their unfaithfulness (R)
decisions.reason: As in verse 7.

source.text: אַתָּ֣ה בֶן־אָדָ֗ם הַגֵּ֤ד אֶת־בֵּֽית־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־הַבַּ֔יִת וְיִכָּלְמ֖וּ מֵעֲוֺנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֑ם וּמָדְד֖וּ אֶת־תָּכְנִֽית׃

records.literal_gloss: You, son of man, describe to [the] house of Israel the house, and let them be ashamed of their iniquities, and let them measure [the] pattern.

en.L: As for you, son of man, describe the house to the house of Israel, and let them be ashamed of their iniquities; and let them measure [its] pattern.
en.B: As for you, son of man, describe the temple to the house of Israel, so that they will be ashamed of their sins, and let them study its plan.
en.R: Son of man, you must describe the temple to the people of Israel. Then they will be ashamed of their sins. Let them study its plan carefully.

es.L: Tú, hijo de hombre, describe la casa a la casa de Israel, y que se avergüencen de sus iniquidades; y que midan [su] diseño.
es.B: Y tú, hijo de hombre, describe el templo a la casa de Israel, para que se avergüencen de sus pecados, y que estudien su plano.
es.R: Hijo de hombre, describe el templo al pueblo de Israel. Así se avergonzarán de sus pecados. Que estudien su plano con cuidado.

fr.L: Toi, fils d’homme, décris la maison à la maison d’Israël, et qu’ils aient honte de leurs iniquités ; et qu’ils en mesurent le plan.
fr.B: Et toi, fils d’homme, décris le temple à la maison d’Israël, afin qu’ils aient honte de leurs péchés, et qu’ils en étudient le plan.
fr.R: Fils d’homme, tu dois décrire le temple au peuple d’Israël. Alors ils auront honte de leurs péchés. Qu’ils en étudient le plan avec soin.

sw.L: Wewe, mwana wa binadamu, waeleze nyumba ya Israeli habari ya nyumba hii, nao waone aibu kwa ajili ya maovu yao; na wapime kielelezo [chake].
sw.B: Na wewe, mwana wa binadamu, ieleze nyumba ya Israeli habari ya hekalu hili, ili waone aibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao, na waichunguze ramani yake.
sw.R: Mwana wa binadamu, lazima uwaeleze watu wa Israeli habari ya hekalu hili. Ndipo wataona aibu kwa ajili ya dhambi zao. Na waichunguze ramani yake kwa makini.

vi.L: Còn ngươi, hỡi con người, hãy mô tả nhà cho nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, để họ hổ thẹn về những tội ác của họ; và hãy để họ đo kiểu mẫu [của nó].
vi.B: Còn con, hỡi con người, hãy mô tả đền thờ cho nhà Y-sơ-ra-ên, để họ hổ thẹn về tội lỗi của mình, và hãy để họ suy xét kiểu mẫu của đền thờ.
vi.R: Hỡi con người, con phải mô tả đền thờ cho dân Y-sơ-ra-ên. Khi ấy họ sẽ hổ thẹn về tội lỗi của mình. Hãy để họ suy xét kỹ kiểu mẫu của đền thờ.

decisions.choice: let them measure the pattern: let them consider the plan carefully
decisions.reason: The word for pattern is the one used for the plan of the tabernacle shown to Moses (Exodus 25:9, 40) and of the temple given to David (1 Chronicles 28:11-19). To "measure" it is to take its measure, to study it closely.

decisions.choice: ashamed of their iniquities: the vision is meant to lead Israel to repentance
decisions.reason: The beauty and holiness of the house show how far the people had fallen. As in 16:61-63 and 36:31-32, shame for sin comes with the restoration, not before it.

decisions.choice: iniquities (L); sins (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah table gives "iniquity" at Literal and "guilt" or "sin" at Balanced and Readable.

decisions.choice: study its plan (B); study its plan carefully (R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps "measure the pattern". Balanced and Readable say what is meant (m1).

decisions.choice: "tội ác" (L) / "tội lỗi" (B, R) for 'avon
decisions.reason: As the earlier chapters of Ezekiel in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: wapime kielelezo [chake] (Literal); waichunguze ramani yake (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the Hebrew "measure the pattern"; Balanced and Readable say what it means, to study the plan carefully (meaning decision).

source.text: וְאִֽם־נִכְלְמ֞וּ מִכֹּ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־עָשׂ֗וּ צוּרַ֣ת הַבַּ֡יִת וּתְכוּנָת֡וֹ וּמוֹצָאָ֡יו וּמוֹבָאָ֣יו וְֽכָל־צֽוּרֹתָ֡ווְאֵ֣ת כָּל־חֻקֹּתָיו֩ וְכָל־צ֨וּרֹתָ֤יו וְכָל־תּוֹרֹתָיו֙ הוֹדַ֣ע אוֹתָ֔ם וּכְתֹ֖ב לְעֵֽינֵיהֶ֑ם וְיִשְׁמְר֞וּ אֶת־כָּל־צוּרָת֛וֹ וְאֶת־כָּל־חֻקֹּתָ֖יו וְעָשׂ֥וּ אוֹתָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, [the] design of the house and its arrangement and its exits and its entrances and all its designs and all its statutes and all its designs and all its laws, make known to them, and write [it] before their eyes, so that they may keep all its design and all its statutes and do them.

en.L: And if they are ashamed of all that they have done, the design of the house and its arrangement, its exits and its entrances, all its designs, all its statutes, all its designs and all its laws, make known to them, and write [it] down before their eyes, so that they may keep its whole design and all its statutes and carry them out.
en.B: If they are ashamed of all they have done, make known to them the design of the temple, its arrangement, its exits and entrances, its whole design, and all its statutes and laws. Write it down where they can see it, so that they may keep its whole design and all its statutes and carry them out.
en.R: If they are ashamed of everything they have done, explain the temple to them. Show them its design and layout, its exits and entrances, and its whole plan. Teach them all its laws and teachings. Write them down where the people can see them. Then they can follow its whole plan and obey all its laws.

es.L: Y si se avergüenzan de todo lo que han hecho, el diseño de la casa y su disposición, sus salidas y sus entradas, todos sus diseños, todos sus estatutos, todos sus diseños y todas sus leyes, dáselos a conocer, y escríbe[lo] delante de sus ojos, para que guarden todo su diseño y todos sus estatutos y los pongan por obra.
es.B: Si se avergüenzan de todo lo que han hecho, dales a conocer el diseño del templo, su disposición, sus salidas y sus entradas, todo su diseño, y todos sus estatutos y sus leyes. Escríbelo donde ellos lo vean, para que guarden todo su diseño y todos sus estatutos y los pongan por obra.
es.R: Si se avergüenzan de todo lo que han hecho, explícales cómo es el templo. Muéstrales su diseño y su distribución, sus salidas y sus entradas, y todo su plano. Enséñales todas sus leyes y enseñanzas. Escríbelas donde el pueblo pueda verlas. Así podrán seguir todo su plano y obedecer todas sus leyes.

fr.L: Et s’ils ont honte de tout ce qu’ils ont fait, le dessin de la maison et son agencement, ses sorties et ses entrées, tous ses dessins, toutes ses prescriptions, tous ses dessins et toutes ses lois, fais-les-leur connaître, et écris[-les] sous leurs yeux, afin qu’ils gardent tout son dessin et toutes ses prescriptions, et qu’ils les mettent en pratique.
fr.B: S’ils ont honte de tout ce qu’ils ont fait, fais-leur connaître la forme du temple, son agencement, ses sorties et ses entrées, toute sa forme, toutes ses prescriptions et toutes ses lois. Mets-les par écrit sous leurs yeux, afin qu’ils respectent toute sa forme et toutes ses prescriptions, et qu’ils les mettent en pratique.
fr.R: S’ils ont honte de tout ce qu’ils ont fait, explique-leur le temple. Montre-leur sa forme et son plan, ses sorties et ses entrées, toute son organisation. Enseigne-leur toutes ses lois et tous ses enseignements. Écris-les là où le peuple pourra les voir. Alors ils pourront suivre tout son plan et obéir à toutes ses lois.

sw.L: Na ikiwa wataona aibu kwa ajili ya yote waliyoyafanya, umbo la nyumba na mpangilio wake, njia zake za kutokea na njia zake za kuingia, maumbo yake yote, amri zake zote, maumbo yake yote na sheria zake zote, uwajulishe, na uyaandike mbele ya macho yao, ili walishike umbo lake lote na amri zake zote na kuzitenda.
sw.B: Ikiwa wataona aibu kwa ajili ya yote waliyoyafanya, wajulishe umbo la hekalu, mpangilio wake, njia zake za kutokea na za kuingia, umbo lake lote, pamoja na amri zake zote na mafundisho yake. Uyaandike mahali wanapoweza kuyaona, ili walishike umbo lake lote na amri zake zote na kuzitekeleza.
sw.R: Ikiwa wataona aibu kwa ajili ya yote waliyoyafanya, waeleze habari ya hekalu. Waonyeshe umbo lake na mpangilio wake, njia zake za kutokea na za kuingia, na ramani yake yote. Wafundishe sheria zake zote na mafundisho yake. Yaandike mahali watu wanapoweza kuyaona. Ndipo wataweza kufuata ramani yake yote na kutii sheria zake zote.

vi.L: Nếu họ hổ thẹn về mọi điều họ đã làm, thì hình dạng của nhà và cách sắp đặt của nó, các lối ra và các lối vào của nó, mọi hình dạng của nó, mọi luật lệ của nó, mọi hình dạng của nó và mọi luật của nó, hãy cho họ biết, và hãy viết [ra] trước mắt họ, để họ giữ toàn bộ hình dạng của nó và mọi luật lệ của nó mà làm theo.
vi.B: Nếu họ hổ thẹn về mọi điều mình đã làm, hãy cho họ biết hình dạng của đền thờ, cách sắp đặt, các lối ra và lối vào, toàn bộ hình dạng của nó, cùng mọi luật lệ và luật của nó. Hãy viết ra trước mắt họ, để họ giữ toàn bộ hình dạng ấy và mọi luật lệ của nó mà làm theo.
vi.R: Nếu họ hổ thẹn về mọi điều mình đã làm, hãy giải thích cho họ về đền thờ. Hãy chỉ cho họ hình dạng và cách bố trí của đền thờ, các lối ra và lối vào, và toàn bộ kiểu mẫu của nó. Hãy dạy họ mọi luật lệ và lời chỉ dạy về đền thờ. Hãy viết ra cho dân chúng thấy. Như vậy họ có thể làm theo toàn bộ kiểu mẫu ấy và vâng giữ mọi luật lệ của nó.

decisions.choice: all its designs ... all its designs: a repeated phrase
decisions.reason: The list names "all its designs" twice; the second time the written text and the reading tradition differ slightly. It may be a scribe's repetition. The Septuagint has a shorter list. The repetition does not change the sense.

decisions.choice: statutes and laws: the regulations for the temple's use
decisions.reason: "Statutes" (*chuqqot*) and "laws" (*torot*) here are the rules for worship in the temple, given from 43:13 to 46:24.

decisions.choice: statutes (L, B) and laws (R) for chuqqot; laws (L, B) and teachings (R) for torot
decisions.reason: The book's usual wording for *chuqqot* (statutes / statutes / laws); *torot* is "laws" at Literal and Balanced and "teachings" at Readable, as the Isaiah table gives *torah*.

decisions.choice: "estatutos" (L, B), "leyes" (R) for chuqqot; "leyes" (L, B), "enseñanzas" (R) for torot
decisions.reason: Following the Spanish note for Ezekiel (chuqqot "estatutos" / "leyes"); torot, the plural of torah, is "leyes" where it stands beside "estatutos", and "enseñanzas" at R, as the published Psalms use "enseñanza" for torah at R.

decisions.choice: "luật lệ" for chuqqot at every level; "luật" (L, B) / "lời chỉ dạy" (R) for torot
decisions.reason: The Ezekiel term sheet keeps "luật lệ" for statutes at every level, as the Pentateuch; torah here is the instruction for the temple, which Readable says plainly, as the English R's "teachings".

decisions.choice: amri (Literal, Balanced), sheria (Readable) for chuqqot; sheria (Literal), mafundisho (Balanced, Readable) for torot
decisions.reason: As the term sheet for Ezekiel's statutes (amri / amri / sheria) and the Isaiah note for torah (sheria at Literal, mafundisho at Balanced and Readable).

source.text: זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֣ת הַבָּ֑יִת עַל־רֹ֣אשׁ הָ֠הָר כָּל־גְּבֻל֞וֹ סָבִ֤יב׀סָבִיב֙ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָדָשִׁ֔ים הִנֵּה־זֹ֖את תּוֹרַ֥ת הַבָּֽיִת׃

records.literal_gloss: This [is] [the] law of the house: on [the] top of the mountain all its territory all around all around [will be] most holy. Look, this [is] [the] law of the house.

en.L: This [is] the law of the house: on the mountaintop, all its territory all around [will be] most holy. Look, this [is] the law of the house.
en.B: This is the law of the temple: all the area around it on the top of the mountain will be most holy. This, then, is the law of the temple.
en.R: This is the main rule for the temple: the whole area around it on top of the mountain will be most holy. This is the rule for the temple.

es.L: Esta [es] la ley de la casa: sobre la cumbre del monte, todo su territorio alrededor [será] santísimo. He aquí, esta [es] la ley de la casa.
es.B: Esta es la ley del templo: toda el área que lo rodea sobre la cumbre del monte será santísima. Esta es, pues, la ley del templo.
es.R: Esta es la regla principal para el templo: toda el área que lo rodea en la cima del monte será santísima. Esta es la regla para el templo.

fr.L: Voici la loi de la maison : sur le sommet de la montagne, tout son territoire, tout autour, [sera] très saint. Voici, telle [est] la loi de la maison.
fr.B: Voici la loi du temple : tout l’espace qui l’entoure, au sommet de la montagne, sera très saint. Telle est donc la loi du temple.
fr.R: Voici la règle principale pour le temple : tout l’espace qui l’entoure, au sommet de la montagne, sera très saint. C’est la règle pour le temple.

sw.L: Hii [ndiyo] sheria ya nyumba: juu ya kilele cha mlima, eneo lake lote pande zote [litakuwa] takatifu kabisa. Tazama, hii [ndiyo] sheria ya nyumba.
sw.B: Hii ndiyo sheria ya hekalu: eneo lote linalolizunguka juu ya kilele cha mlima litakuwa takatifu kabisa. Basi, hii ndiyo sheria ya hekalu.
sw.R: Hii ndiyo kanuni kuu ya hekalu: eneo lote linalolizunguka juu ya mlima litakuwa takatifu sana. Hii ndiyo kanuni ya hekalu.

vi.L: Đây [là] luật của nhà: trên đỉnh núi, toàn bộ địa phận của nó chung quanh, khắp chung quanh, [sẽ là] chí thánh. Kìa, đây [là] luật của nhà.
vi.B: Đây là luật của đền thờ: toàn bộ khu vực chung quanh đền thờ trên đỉnh núi sẽ là chí thánh. Vậy, đây là luật của đền thờ.
vi.R: Đây là quy tắc chính cho đền thờ: cả khu vực chung quanh đền thờ trên đỉnh núi sẽ rất thánh. Đó là quy tắc cho đền thờ.

decisions.choice: the law of the house: the basic instruction for the temple
decisions.reason: The word *torah* means instruction or teaching. Here it is the rule that governs the whole temple: its area is most holy. The phrase frames the verse, before and after.

decisions.choice: most holy: the whole temple mount shares the holiness of the inner room
decisions.reason: "Most holy" was used of the inner room (41:4) and of the most holy offerings (42:13). Now the whole area on the mountain is most holy, so that the holiness of the LORD's presence reaches out across the whole mountain (compare Zechariah 14:20-21).

decisions.choice: the law (L, B); the rule (R)
decisions.reason: The Isaiah table gives *torah* as "instruction" or "teaching", but here it means a regulation for the building, so "law" (L, B) and "rule" (R) are used, as in verse 11.

decisions.choice: "la loi du temple" (B) / "la règle" (R) for torah here
alternatives: "l'instruction du temple" (B), as the term sheet's wording for God's torah
decisions.reason: Here torah is the regulation of the temple (the English "law" / "rule"), not God's teaching to his people, so French follows the English sense rather than the term sheet's "instruction" / "enseignement".

decisions.choice: sheria (Literal, Balanced); kanuni (Readable)
decisions.reason: Here torah is a ruling for the temple (meaning decision), so Balanced keeps "sheria" rather than the "mafundisho" used for torah as teaching; Readable says "kanuni" (rule), as the English Readable says "rule".

source.text: וְאֵ֨לֶּה מִדּ֤וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ בָּֽאַמּ֔וֹת אַמָּ֥ה אַמָּ֖ה וָטֹ֑פַח וְחֵ֨יק הָאַמָּ֜ה וְאַמָּה־רֹ֗חַב וּגְבוּלָ֨הּ אֶל־שְׂפָתָ֤הּ סָבִיב֙ זֶ֣רֶת הָאֶחָ֔ד וְזֶ֖ה גַּ֥ב הַמִּזְבֵּֽחַ׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are] [the] measurements of the altar by cubits, the cubit [being] a cubit and a handbreadth: and the gutter a cubit, and a cubit [the] breadth, and its border to its edge around one span; and this [is] [the] base of the altar.

en.L: And these [are] the measurements of the altar in cubits, the cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: the gutter, a cubit [deep], and a cubit wide, and its rim around its edge, one span. And this [is] the base of the altar.
en.B: These are the measurements of the altar in long cubits, each a cubit and a handbreadth: its gutter was {{units:about 21 inches|a cubit}} deep and {{units:about 21 inches|a cubit}} wide, with a rim of {{units:about 10 1/2 inches|half a cubit}} around its edge. This is the base of the altar.
en.R: These are the measurements of the altar. The gutter around its base was {{units:about 21 inches|a cubit}} deep and {{units:about 21 inches|a cubit}} wide. It had a rim {{units:about 10 1/2 inches|half a cubit}} wide around its edge. This is the base of the altar.

es.L: Y estas [son] las medidas del altar en codos, siendo el codo un codo y un ancho de mano: el canal, un codo [de hondo], y un codo de ancho, y su borde alrededor de su orilla, un palmo. Y esta [es] la base del altar.
es.B: Estas son las medidas del altar en codos largos, de un codo y un ancho de mano cada uno: su canal tenía {{units:unos 53 centímetros|un codo}} de hondo y {{units:unos 53 centímetros|un codo}} de ancho, con un borde de {{units:unos 26 centímetros|medio codo}} alrededor de su orilla. Esta es la base del altar.
es.R: Estas son las medidas del altar. El canal que rodeaba su base tenía {{units:unos 53 centímetros|un codo}} de hondo y {{units:unos 53 centímetros|un codo}} de ancho. Tenía un borde de {{units:unos 26 centímetros|medio codo}} de ancho alrededor de su orilla. Esta es la base del altar.

decisions.choice: the cubit being a cubit and a handbreadth: the long cubit of 40:5
decisions.reason: The altar is measured with the same long cubit as the temple, about 21 inches (see 40:5).

decisions.choice: the gutter: a channel around the base of the altar
decisions.reason: The word means "bosom" or "hollow". It names a trench or channel at the foot of the altar, a cubit deep and a cubit wide, perhaps to catch the blood poured at its base (Leviticus 4:7).

decisions.choice: a span: half a cubit
decisions.reason: A span is the distance between the tips of the thumb and the little finger of a spread hand, half a cubit, about 10 1/2 inches on the long cubit.

decisions.choice: the base of the altar: the lowest part, on which it stood
decisions.reason: The word means "back" or "mound". Here it seems to name the base or foundation platform of the altar.

decisions.choice: {{units:about 21 inches|a cubit}}; {{units:about 10 1/2 inches|half a cubit}} (B, R)
decisions.reason: On the long cubit of 40:5. A span is half a cubit.

decisions.choice: gutter (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same word is used for this channel in verses 14 and 17.

decisions.choice: "el canal" (all levels); "un palmo" (L) for the span
decisions.reason: The gutter is a channel round the foot of the altar; "canal" names it without guessing more. The span (zeret) is "palmo", the distance across an open hand, kept apart from the handbreadth, "un ancho de mano" (Exodus 25:25).

decisions.choice: present tense at Balanced and Readable in 43:13-17 ("sa rigole a ...")
alternatives: the past tense of the English ("was")
decisions.reason: The description of the altar is part of what the voice from the temple says (the quotation opened at 43:7 closes at 43:17), and French speech describes in the present.

decisions.choice: "la rigole" for the gutter, "le rebord" for the rim, and (verse 14) "le gradin" for the ledge, at every level
decisions.reason: Plain words for a stepped altar: a channel at the foot, a raised edge, and the steps of the structure; "gradin" keeps the ledges apart from the rim.

decisions.choice: "bề tay" for tefach (handbreadth), "gang tay" for zeret (span)
decisions.reason: Two different measures: the handbreadth (about 7.5 cm) that makes the long cubit, as 1 Kings 7:26, and the span (half a cubit). The units spans in this chapter are worked out on the long cubit of 53 cm.

decisions.choice: "rãnh" for the gutter and "gờ viền" for the rim
decisions.reason: Plain words for a channel at the foot of the altar and the raised edge around it.

decisions.choice: mfereji (gutter); ukingo (rim); shibiri (span, Literal)
decisions.reason: Plain words for the parts of the altar's base; Literal keeps the Hebrew "span" as "shibiri", which Balanced and Readable give as half a long cubit (meaning decision).

sw.L: Na kutoka mfereji ulio ardhini mpaka daraja la chini [ni] dhiraa mbili, na upana dhiraa moja; na kutoka daraja dogo mpaka daraja kubwa [ni] dhiraa nne, na upana dhiraa moja.

vi.L: Từ cái rãnh trên mặt đất đến gờ dưới [là] hai cu-đê, và bề rộng một cu-đê; và từ gờ nhỏ đến gờ lớn [là] bốn cu-đê, và bề rộng một cu-đê.

vi.R: Từ rãnh ở mặt đất lên đến gờ dưới cao {{units:khoảng 1,1 m|hai cu-đê}}. Gờ dưới rộng {{units:khoảng 53 cm|một cu-đê}}. Từ gờ dưới lên đến gờ trên cao {{units:khoảng 2,1 m|bốn cu-đê}}. Gờ trên cũng rộng {{units:khoảng 53 cm|một cu-đê}}.

decisions.choice: ledge: a step or setback around the altar
decisions.reason: The word names a ledge where each stage of the altar was set back from the one below. The altar rose in stages, narrower at each level, like a stepped tower. 45:19 speaks of the corners of the ledge.

decisions.choice: the smaller ledge ... the larger ledge: the lower and the upper ledges
decisions.reason: "Smaller" and "larger" seem to refer to the height of the stage below each ledge (two and four cubits), so the smaller ledge is the lower one.

decisions.choice: ledge (all levels)
decisions.reason: The same word is used for these setbacks through 43:14-20 and 45:19.

decisions.choice: "escalón" (all levels)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word names a setback in the side of a stepped altar. "Escalón" makes the shape plain; "cornisa" would suggest a moulding that juts out.

decisions.choice: "gờ" for the ledge ('azarah)
decisions.reason: A step-back running around the altar; the same word as the ledges of 41:6.

decisions.choice: daraja (ledge)
decisions.reason: A step or setback in the altar (meaning decision); "daraja" (step, tier) is kept apart from "vipandio", the ledges in the temple wall (41:6).

decisions.choice: the altar hearth: the top of the altar, where the fire burned
decisions.reason: Two forms of the word are used here. One looks like "mountain of God" and the other like "lion of God", the name Ariel that Isaiah gives Jerusalem (Isaiah 29:1-2). The word is found on a ninth-century Moabite inscription for some kind of altar object. Its sense here is the fire pit on top of the altar.

decisions.choice: the horns: projections at the four corners of the altar
decisions.reason: Altars had horn-shaped corners (Exodus 27:2). Blood was put on them in the sin offering (verse 20; Leviticus 4:7), and a fugitive could take hold of them (1 Kings 1:50).

decisions.choice: the altar hearth (L, B); the top part of the altar, where the fire burned (R)
decisions.reason: Readable explains the rare word (m1) the first time and says "altar hearth" in verse 16.

decisions.choice: "el fogón del altar" (L, B); "la parte de arriba del altar, donde ardía el fuego" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word for the top of the altar, where the fire burned, is rare; "fogón" names a hearth for fire. R describes it, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: "lò bàn thờ" (L, B) for the altar hearth
decisions.reason: The top of the altar where the fire burned; Readable explains it, as the English R does.

decisions.choice: meko ya madhabahu (altar hearth)
decisions.reason: "Meko" is the hearth where a fire burns, the sense the meaning decision gives; Readable explains it as the English Readable does.
